issues.where: whole frame, soil and plant surfaces

issues.fix: re-grade and re-texture soil toward a: deeper warm-black clods, larger organic chunks, wet specular highlights, film grain and photographic micro-contrast

issues.where: whole frame, soil and plant surfaces

issues.fix: add sun rays/starburst, warm flare and atmospheric glow around the sun and over the right field

issues.what: a's sun sits lower behind the skyline with starburst rays and strong rim-lit haze; b's sun is a diffuse disc, no rays, flatter haze
issues.fix: add starburst and warm flare, lower the sun to the skyline, increase backlit haze

issues.where: right-side grass clump and left foreground
issues.what: a has a dense dewy grass tuft with sparkling backlit droplets at right and small sprouts scattered in the midground; b has a sparse, clean, smooth-bladed clump with no dew glints, and a new tall in-focus-ish grass blade at left-center not in a
issues.fix: thicken the right tuft with dewy backlit blades and glints, restore scattered small sprouts, remove/blur the left-center blade

issues.what: a has one or two broad blades at the far left edge, rising to the top; b has a tall cluster of thin blades with bright bokeh dots/dew balls that are not in a
issues.fix: match a's blade count, width and position; remove the extra bokeh droplets

issues.what: seed coat in a is crusted with soil specks and has white-cream stripes with a pale green tip; b's coat is clean gray with smooth wavy dark stripes, more open with a bright lime cotyledon showing along its length, and hangs more to the right/lower; soil particles on stem are large discrete black cubes rather than fine crumbs
issues.fix: add soil grit to the coat, restore cream-white striping and a mostly closed coat, replace the cube-like particles with fine irregular crumbs

issues.what: a's stem is thicker, with a strong magenta-red base and dense backlit hairs; b's stem is thinner, paler pink, hook narrower
issues.fix: thicken the stem, deepen the red-magenta base color, strengthen rim-lit hairs

issues.fix: warm and add translucency/rim light to the leaves, reduce droplets to a's fine scattered dew, soften the central bud, clean the stem

issues.what: a's husk is two upright gray striped halves standing to the left of the stem; b's husk is smaller, whiter, lying lower and further left
issues.fix: match the husk's size, upright pose, gray striping and position

issues.what: a's skyline is a soft misty line of trees and fog; b shows a distinct dark hill/mountain shape at upper left and a flat band below, plus an orange bokeh blob not in a

issues.what: a's skyline is a ridge of trees with mist rolling over the field; b has a smooth single hill and a flat gray water-like band, no mist layer, no tree texture
issues.fix: add ground mist and tree texture to the ridge, remove the flat band

issues.what: b's sky is slightly cooler at top and smoother with no grain; a has visible film grain and pinker horizon
